A massive Texas cancer research initiative saved tens of thousands of lives, despite early opposition from key conservatives.

Ken Paxton & CPRIT Funding
Evidence: fiscal opposition, life-saving impact, public health
#Aletheia #USPol

Ken Paxton opposed billions in public funding and vaccine mandates in 2007, citing fiscal conservatism and state debt concerns.
Stated Judgement: (-0.5, -0.5) — Lesser Evil

Resulting Judgement: (-1.2, -1.0) — Greater Evil

Ideological opposition to life-saving health initiatives created long-term public harm.

- CPRIT Opposition: FAIL (-1.2, -1.0) — Fought multi-billion research.
- HPV Vaccine Bar: FAIL (-1.1, -0.9) — Blocked cancer prevention.

A classic ideological pretense masking harmful policy outcomes.
